contracts.name: slice4-postponed-auction
coverage: malformed body rejected before storage mutation

handwritten_no_stdlib_equivalent.reason: A handwritten equivalent would reimplement raw map-based postponement that Stage 2 now warns against; Stage 3 records the focused stdlib gas baseline and defers larger trait/package budget comparison to Stage 4/5.

stage5_trait_coverage.budget_justification: Stage 5 adds JSON manifests and a read-only validation path only; no Tol contract or stdlib source is changed, so existing BoC hashes remain governed by the Slice 3/Slice 1 baselines.
